Repository and component ownership

PathResponsibility
shared/catalog.jsonThirty entities, three store models and approved physical countries.
poc/seed.pyEleven scenario factories and global-ID fixtures.
poc/app.pyFastAPI, physical adapters, composite SQL keys, outbox, import, reads and impact planner.
poc/policies/Actual OPA/Rego rules; original and migration test suites.
dist/engine.jsLabelled browser simulation, checked against actual policy.
dist/app.js / land.jsonGlobal map, entity registry, policy editor, generator and inspector.
poc/tests/Engine workflow test and local API integration suite.
compose.yamlFour database nodes, four OPA services, local HTTP gateway, harness and OTel Collector.

Implementation sequence

01Run and verify locally

Compose and integration tests; inspect physical SQL rows for denied routes.

02Add authenticated boundaries

Regional gateways, scoped identities and service credentials.

03Replace in-process fencing

Per-owner ordering, generation and placement-version admission.

04Harden evidence and transport

Regional bus/CDC, retry backoff, immutable audit and telemetry controls.

Acceptance gates

GateProof
OwnershipTwo masters with the same global ID stay independent across owner entities.
Shared storeUK entity two allowed, entity three excluded, both hosted in London.
Geographic denyCanadian recipient cannot receive a US-stored copy when US is excluded.
Placement failureFive synthetic country-local entities have no valid deployment in the three-store fixture.
LifecycleExpiry, narrowing, pause/revoke/resume and stale edits behave correctly.
ReplayLost acknowledgement and stale-generation import cannot duplicate or resurrect data.
MigrationOriginal impact plan remains read-only; isolated relocation has explicit authority and cleanup gates.
EvidenceUI status, API read response and actual database contents agree.

A focused prompt with scope, contracts and acceptance criteria.

Read the full prompt
Continue from the validated four-store Docker lab and 30-entity catalog. Preserve separate CockroachDB single nodes, source/destination OPA admission, durable audit and the loopback gateway. The India migration fixture is separate from normalized business table migration. Treat regional HA, authenticated services and distributed fencing as bounded pilot extensions with new ADRs and real fault evidence; do not infer them from the local topology. Prioritise database crash and partition recovery, recipient-commit/source-ack gaps and migration authority boundaries. Run the existing acceptance gates and report failures without skipping assertions. Add normalized-table migration and regional identity/TLS only as separately scoped changes.
